name: Say The Line Bart
look: Three stacked frames from The Simpsons. Top: Principal Skinner, Mrs. Krabappel and grinning classmates including Milhouse lean in eagerly. Middle: Bart sits at his desk looking down, bored and reluctant. Bottom: the whole classroom erupts in cheers with arms in the air.
use: A crowd demands a catchphrase and goes wild when it is delivered. The top asks someone to say the line, the middle is the tired, predictable line they always say, and the bottom is everyone cheering.
slots: the crowd's demand: say the line (top)
examples: Have you tried turning it off and on again?
Who left all the lights on in here?
